whatsappMessage:
Hi Wat-a-burger Team,

I noticed your Boring Road outlet has strong 4.5★ reviews from 450+ food lovers in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering page for quick local takeaways and delivery inquiries.

Maine aapke outlet ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, burger specials, aur store timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/wataburger

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Wat-a-burger Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke Boring Road outlet ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering and mobile-first speed for Patna customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items aur delivery setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
